issues.what: The film opens offshore on the rib silhouettes. The target wide's near left bank and the channel it frames are missing until the camera reaches the shallows around 0:19.
issues.fix: Start on a wide that includes the left bank and frames the receding rib corridor, then move past the bank and into the place.

issues.what: The frame goes featureless blue across consecutive samples before the overhead lake appears. The pullback after that reads continuously, but the blue interval hides the connection to the lake-level move.
issues.fix: Keep a visible lake landmark through the tilt and climb so the lake-level shot resolves into the overhead view without a visual reset.

issues.where: the orbit settle around 2:48 through the fade
issues.what: The nearly unchanged orbit view holds for roughly 25–30 seconds after the rise has already made its reveal, leaving the last stretch markedly slower than the rest of the film.
issues.fix: Give the whole-body composition a short readable hold, then fade sooner.

issues.where: the settled orbit composition from 2:48 onward
issues.what: The visible curved limb runs out of frame; the pullback stops at a view of the body that does not show its complete outline.
issues.fix: Pull farther back and center the whole body with clear space around its perimeter before settling.

note: I did not infer lack of motion in the first two seconds or definite internal hard cuts from the sampled stills. Only shore has a direct target image; the other place opens can be judged as wides, not checked against targets.
